thread:
Sam: Quick decision needed on default priority/fairness for reserved pools. Customers want fair share during contention but also predictable reserved guarantees. Options: 1) strict reserved-first then fair-share for leftover, 2) weighted fairness where reservations are weights in proportional allocator, 3) hybrid: reserved baseline + small dynamic multiplier that helps during short spikes. Thoughts?

Priya: Customers hate opaque multipliers. Sales prefers simple rules: baseline guaranteed, then a transparent multiplier that’s just "commitment-tier * 1x" by default. But product needs something to smooth launches.

Noah: Runtime: pure reserved-first causes cliff effects when many tenants max out. Weighted fairness is fair but can starve small customers. Hybrid seems best: guaranteed baseline always honored, then an adaptive multiplier (max 2x baseline) for short bursts only, decays over 1h.

Arjun: Implementation note: multiplier = min(2.0, baseline*(1 + alpha*recent_tail)). Compute recent_tail as 95th-percentile delta over 15m. Cap changes to avoid oscillation: update rate=5m. Also provide per-tenant override opt-in for Enterprise.

Priya: UX: Console shows "priority multiplier" and a simple explanation: "Boosts your reserved throughput briefly during spikes (up to 2x)." Default off for Standard, on for Dedicated by default with cap 60m/month. Enterprise can bump caps. Also add a toggle to disable adaptive adjustments.

Sam: Ops/runbook: alert when >10 tenants have active multiplier>1.5 for >20m in a region. Eviction order when reclaim needed: opportunistic -> dynamic-multiplier capacity -> reserved baseline (never evict). Pager only if reclaimed multiplier >75% global buffer for >30m.

Noah: Router changes: add weight in allocator for dynamic-multiplier tag, emit metrics: multiplier-active-count, multiplier-usage-minutes, multiplier-reclaims. Add chaos test for 50 concurrent spikes.

Arjun: Billing: prefer monthly cap model (e.g., 60m free multiplier minutes), avoid per-minute surcharge. Sales wants examples in pricing page.

ops-bot: scheduled: create-epic "reserved-priority-multiplier" assigned to @Sam,@Priya,@Noah,@Arjun due 2025-05-16

Sam: Decision proposal: GA default = hybrid model (reserved baseline + adaptive multiplier up to 2x, decay 1h, update rate 5m), Standard: off or capped, Dedicated: on with 60m/month free, Enterprise: configurable. Owners: Arjun infra proto, Noah router + tests, Priya pricing + console copy, Sam runbook. Lock in by EOD Friday unless objections. :thumbsup:
